parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The spectrum of the light emerging from the cloud of cool gas is viewed using a diffraction grating.
Explain why this spectrum contains a number of dark lines.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Light of wavelength $420\text{ nm}$ has a photon energy of $2.96\text{ eV}$.
Calculate the photon energy, in $\text{eV}$, of light of wavelength $740\text{ nm}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Use data from (i) and your answer in (i) to show, on Fig. 11.2, the changes in energy levels giving rise to the dark lines in (a).

stem:
A beam of light consists of a continuous range of wavelengths from $420\text{ nm}$ to $740\text{ nm}$. The light passes through a cloud of cool gas, as shown in Fig. 11.1.
